data.name: Pit Wars
data.detailed_description:
About the Game

Pit Wars is a fast-paced 2–4 player online PvP heist game centered around deception, strategy, and high-risk digging combat.
Each player owns a backyard with three diggable pits, hides their money inside them, sets dangerous traps, and then raids other players’ pits to steal their stash.
Every match is a mix of planning, bluffing, and chaotic action.

Gameplay Overview

🔧 Preparation Phase

Before the action starts, each player prepares their territory:

  • Hide your money inside one of your three pits

  • Place various trap types inside each pit (damage traps, alarms, fake pits, slow traps, etc.)

  • Purchase anti-trap tools to protect yourself during raids

  • Misdirect opponents by creating convincing decoys

  • Strategically plan how to defend your own pits while planning your assault

This phase focuses heavily on strategy, mind games, and risk management.

⚔️ Raid Phase

Once the match begins, players invade each other's backyards to dig up their pits:

  • Dig through multiple layers in each pit (every pit has 4 layers, each layer may contain traps)

  • Use your anti-trap tools to survive surprises

  • Locate the correct pit, steal the money, and escape

  • Defend your own backyard while attacking others

  • Face constant pressure as multiple players act simultaneously

This phase delivers high tension, quick decisions, and unpredictable chaos.

Key Features

  • 2–4 player online PvP

  • Quick Match for instant matchmaking

  • Steam Lobby support for friend groups

  • Each player has 3 customizable, multi-layer pits

  • Layered digging system (4 layers per pit with hidden traps)

  • Multiple trap types: explosive, misleading, alarm-triggering, slowing, and more

  • Anti-trap equipment for counterplay

  • Fast, repeatable matches full of surprise and deception

  • Progression system with passive upgrades and single-use active items

The Experience

Pit Wars blends strategy, psychological warfare, and real-time action.
Every match feels different—new trap layouts, new bluff plays, new raid tactics.
Trust no one. Everyone is both the hunter and the hunted.

data.short_description: Pit Wars is a 2–4 player online PvP heist game where everyone hides their money in booby-trapped pits and then digs up other players’ pits to steal their stash. Build traps, outsmart opponents, and survive the chaos. Steal more money, buy more traps, build up your strategy and win them all!
